components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to E.164
            form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped, a leading '+' and country code
            are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must be a '+'
            followed by 8 to 15 digits; that canonical value is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be
            valid for the owner's city per the fixed region ranges (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), while a city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on create; when omitted it
            defaults to the server's current date. Formatted as an ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag set on create to acknowledge that this owner deliberately
            shares a household with an existing owner. When true, the create is allowed
            even though another owner already has the same last name and address;
            otherwise such a duplicate is rejected. Never stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted as '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3
                and LAST3 are the upper-cased first three letters of the city and last name
                and NNNN is a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: SYD-FRA-0007
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted as '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where
                YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year. Derived on read
                from the owner's customer code and registration date.
              type: string
              example: SYD-FRA-0007-M26
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned on create. It starts at 1,
                gains a point when the owner has an email address and another when the
                owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), and is capped at 3. Level 4
                is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality: the canonical region derived on read from the
                city via a fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read: 'EMAIL' when the
                owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by owners who belong to the same household
                (same last name and address). Assigned on create when the owner joins
                an existing household via the 'sharesHousehold' flag; absent otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 3F9A2B7C1D0E
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key used to detect duplicate owners on create. It is the
                owner's normalized telephone, email and household id joined with '|' as
                '<telephone>|<email>|<householdId>', with a missing email or household id
                contributing an empty segment. Two owners are duplicates (rejected on create)
                only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||3F9A2B7C1D0E'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners already stored when this owner was created that
                share its first name and last name, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether the owner's registration day was already busy when this owner was
                created: true when more than 80 owners had already been created on that day,
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

The spec required returning `checkDigit` — a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of the owner's `customerCode`. I followed the codebase's established pattern for derived, read-only owner fields (like `membershipNumber`, `locality`, `identityKey`), where the value is declared in the OpenAPI schema, computed by a `@Transient` getter on the model, and auto-mapped by MapStruct.

Changes:

1. **`model/Luhn.java`** (new) — a small, single-responsibility helper holding just the Luhn algorithm (`checkDigit(String)`, ignoring non-digits). This mirrors how `getLocality` delegates to `RegionPostcodeTable`, keeping the algorithm out of the entity and reusable.

2. **`model/Owner.java`** — added a `@Transient getCheckDigit()` returning `Luhn.checkDigit(customerCode)`, or `null` before the code is assigned (consistent with `getMembershipNumber`'s null handling).

3. **`resources/openapi.yml`** — added the `checkDigit` property (read-only integer, 0–9) to the `Owner` schema so the generated `OwnerDto` exposes it and MapStruct maps it automatically.

The `AcceptanceTest.coreCheckDigitIsLuhnOfCustomerCode` test — which recomputes Luhn from the returned `customerCode` and asserts the exact digit — passes, and `BUILD SUCCESS` for the full suite.
